title: Flimsy & unstable
text: Flimsy & unstable. Love the fact that it was manufactured in the USA and that it is very light weight.  I was not able to use it because, being light weight, it was flimsy and wobbly

product_metadata.title: Homz Blue Stripe 4 Leg Ironing Board
features: FOUR STEEL LEG FOUNDATION: Four sturdy and durable metal legs provide superior stability while ironing and the non-skid feet protect your tile or wood flooring
54” x 14” PERFORATED STEEL TOP: Offers a large ironing surface and evenly distributes heat and steam onto garments, eliminating wrinkles effortlessly
100% COTTON COVER: A smooth cotton cover with a polyurethane foam pad allows your iron to glide across your garments and leave them wrinkle free
ADJUSTS TO ANY HEIGHT: Conveniently adjusts to any height, up to 40.5” tall
FOLDS FLAT: The patented leg lock design enables this heavy duty board to easily collapse and transport securely when not in use
MADE IN THE USA: Homz is proud to be the only U.S. manufacturer of steel ironing tables
description: The Homz 4-Leg Ironing Board is the go-to laundry solution for handling wrinkles and revitalizing your wardrobe. The steel mesh top is designed for improved steam flow when ironing and the 54" long by 14" wide ironing top provides ample space for garments of all sizes. A smooth 100% cotton cover with polyurethane foam pad enables your iron to freely glide across your dress shirts, pants, or sweaters and leave them crisp and wrinkle-free. Four sturdy and durable metal legs provide stability when the board is in use and can conveniently adjust to any height, up to 37.5” tall. The patented leg lock design allows the lightweight board to easily collapse and transport securely to storage when not in use. Cleaning instructions for ironing board cover: Use a damp soft cotton cloth to wipe down the cover and allow to air dry; not machine washable and do not put in dryer. Proudly made in the USA, Homz is the only U.S. manufacturer of ironing boards. For over 65 years, our facility in Seymour, IN has produced high quality steel-top ironing boards built to last for all your garment care needs.
